scope.target: RK3588S: new observations at 20 Hz and VGGT maps every 2-5 seconds

decision.preserve_original_algorithm: Reuse the already verified exact overlap-frame DINO patch-token cache. It saves only repeated image encoding; every new image and the frame/global/camera/depth computation remain.
decision.next_approximation_research_candidate: Co-Me direct MLP merging on one captured original-weight block, before considering attention changes or whole-model deployment.
decision.approval_boundary: Original checkpoint compatibility is not algorithmic equivalence. Token merging and causal streaming change semantics; this report authorizes neither a production model change nor a new realtime claim.
decision.current_short_submap_fastest_route_exclu: FastVGGT retains full QKV and full MLP work. Attention QK/AV accounts for 8.66% of the static 72-block backbone MAC budget for S=2; this is not a measured global-block runtime fraction. No official two-image speed result was found.

original_checkpoint_binding.validation_in_official_loader: Reject all missing parameters and unexpected parameters other than removed track_head parameters.
original_checkpoint_binding.base_architecture: Original 1024-channel ViT-L/14 register-token DINO encoder; 24 encoder blocks, 24 frame blocks, 24 global blocks. No smaller backbone.

released_predictor.architecture: Linear 1024-to-128, one 128-channel single-head transformer block, two reflect-padded 3x3 convolutions to confidence.
released_predictor.training: The predictor was trained; the VGGT base remains frozen. Released predictor removes the need for new predictor training in an experiment.

compute_reduction.direct_semantics: Merge normalized tokens before QKV/attention, split afterward; independently merge normalized tokens before the original MLP and split its output. Original residual paths remain.
compute_reduction.fused_semantics: Compact whole blocks, then expand retained outputs. Averaged RoPE positions are converted to integers; attention uses token-multiplicity correction. This is approximate, even with unchanged VGGT weights.

rk3588_constraints.official_runtime: CUDA/CUTLASS and jagged FlashAttention, with CUDA extension imports. The naive merger contains portable tensor math but its current module import is not a standalone CPU path.
rk3588_constraints.group_grid: Official 3x3 grouping requires both patch-grid dimensions divisible by 3. Our 336 18x24 grid works; 518 28x37 and 112 6x8 do not directly fit that configuration.
rk3588_constraints.mask_dependency: Predictor attention sees all views; its strict-below-median mask is batch dependent and variable-length. Do not reuse the previous complete DINO-tail cache across new view sets under Co-Me.
rk3588_constraints.possible_exact_cache_boundary: The first 15 image-independent DINO blocks precede the context-dependent mask and can remain an exact reuse boundary, subject to identical input/model/backend guards.
rk3588_constraints.static_rknn_route: CPU computes a frozen mask and gather/scatter map; a fixed compact-row MLP is the first tractable RKNN graph. Full jagged attention and its multiplicity bias are separate unvalidated work.

official_performance_limits.quality_caveat: Depth/point-cloud evaluation masks merged regions for all compared methods; these results do not establish whole-image map quality.
official_performance_limits.edge_caveat: The edge demonstration is MapAnything on CUDA Jetson Thor, not VGGT on Rockchip. It does not establish 20 Hz VGGT pose output.

candidates.name: FastVGGT
candidates.recommendation: Do not prioritize for the present two-view submap workload.

code_license.name: Custom Meta VGGT license v1, July 29 2025

candidates.checkpoint_caveat: The official recommended tracker-fixed checkpoint is not the currently validated VGGT-1B checkpoint. Base dimensions remain compatible, but this research did not load or compare weights.
candidates.architecture: Still ViT-L/14 register DINO with 1024-channel, 24 frame/24 global blocks.
candidates.semantics: Full QKV and RoPE precede merging; attention and output projection use fewer tokens; unmerge occurs before the full MLP. Approximate attention, not a reduced full block.
candidates.rknn_obstacles: Matching/gather/scatter scheduling and variable token counts; CUDA FlashAttention cannot be assumed deployable. Large-sequence GPU speedups do not establish short-submap board speedups.

candidates.name: StreamVGGT / InfiniteVGGT
candidates.recommendation: A bounded causal research fork only if changing the model and inference semantics is explicitly accepted; not the current original-checkpoint acceleration route.
candidates.base_architecture: Still ViT-L/14 register DINO, 1024 channels, 24 frame/24 global blocks; every new image retains its image encoder computation.
candidates.semantics: StreamVGGT uses trained causal/distilled weights. InfiniteVGGT reuses these weights and adds bounded KV memory without retraining. Its training-free claim is about memory extension, not conversion of original VGGT weights into a causal model.
candidates.bounds: Infinite applies per-layer bounded KV retention. Stream's default history grows, but its newer paper also describes a bounded window; do not characterize every Stream variant as unbounded.
candidates.integration_risks: Static bounded cache/index design, causal attention export, and original SL4 overlap/loop retrieval interfaces require explicit adapters. A causal pose or TUM output cannot be blindly treated as the original projective graph gauge.

existing_exact_route.measured_scope: Three overlapping two-image 336 batches: pose, depth and confidence bitwise equal; six frame inputs, two hits, four misses. No claim of controlled speedup or general equality for changed inputs/backends.
existing_exact_route.limits: Only the previous batch's final DINO patch tokens are cached. The same image can change first/other camera-token roles, so its first frame block is not a valid cross-role exact cache. Later global-attention outputs depend on the new view set.
existing_exact_route.local_memory_fix_status: Retained-layer filtering already exists locally. Moving concat inside that filter avoids temporary allocations but does not remove transformer-layer computation; do not call it a new 2-3x inference-speed route.

next_small_experiment.name: One original-weight MLP with Co-Me direct mean-merge/split
next_small_experiment.status: Proposal only; not implemented or executed on real tensors.
next_small_experiment.prerequisite_capture: Root captures same-batch DINO block14 features, the chosen block's norm2 input, original MLP/output and exact source/weight hashes on the board.
next_small_experiment.portable_reference: Reimplement only the official mean/group/reverse-index arithmetic with CPU tensor operations; preserve special tokens, original FC weights/bias, exact GELU, LayerScale and residual. Validate synthetic grouping/index contracts before real-board comparison; do not install a large CUDA dependency stack.
next_small_experiment.configuration: Start with the existing 336 18x24 grid and official 3x3 grouping. Use the released predictor or explicitly label a confidence-mask substitute. Freeze the actual mask for this single diagnostic; do not choose it using heldout accuracy or GT.
next_small_experiment.token_budget_example: For two views, 432 patch + 5 special tokens each gives 874 rows. If exactly 48 of the 96 patch groups merge, 490 rows remain; strict quantile ties can change this count. This arithmetic is not a measured speedup.
required_comparisons: CPU direct mean-merge/MLP/split agrees with independently implemented official index/group semantics on small synthetic tensors.
Real board: original MLP versus compact original-weight MLP, explicit special/merged/nonmerged output errors, all-region coverage, gather/split cost and total operator time.
A fixed compact-row RKNN MLP must show actual SDK execution/operator target, no fallback, original-weight binding and end-to-end IO timing.
Only after the isolated diagnostic: unchanged dense-output interface, all-pixel depth/confidence/pose comparisons and original SL4 overlap/loop regression.
forbidden_claims: Whole-image quality retained from masked paper tables
Entirely NPU execution from a single MLP result

synthetic_dependency_check_actually_run.implementation: NumPy float64, seed20; 9x4 tokens; FC1 4-to-8, exact erf GELU, FC2 8-to-4; all weights/bias random in that order.
synthetic_dependency_check_actually_run.conclusion: Mean-merge -> exact MLP -> replicate split changes heterogeneous-token outputs despite retaining the original weights. This proves a semantic boundary, not real-model quality or speed.

source_binding_scope: Architecture, algorithm and license claims are bound to immutable author repository commits and byte hashes below; benchmark claims retain explicit versioned author-paper URLs and hardware labels. Line numbers are one-based. Source/checkpoint metadata were fetched, not checkpoint payloads.
